WHY THIS EXISTS

There are more of us than you think. We just can't see each other.

Since launching HER HORIZONS AI, one thing has really struck me: there are so many women working in AI right now. I know women building businesses, leading AI projects, working in data and engineering, strategy, transformation, research and product. But honestly, we don't always know where each other are. And I think that's a shame.

That's really why I started this. I wanted to create a space where we can actually find each other — to connect, have conversations, share what we're working on, ask questions, exchange ideas, and hopefully open a few doors for each other along the way.

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY FIND HERE

Three things this is for.

01

Real conversations

Not curated content. Actual women naming what they're building, what's broken, and what they need help with right now.

02

Warm introductions

The right person is often one conversation away. This exists so that conversation actually happens instead of staying invisible.

03

Visibility for your work

If you're building something in AI, this is a place to say so out loud — without having to perform confidence you don't feel yet.
